description: Represents a figure or table caption as ONE caption block: the short titled/numbered label that describes an adjacent figure or table (e.g. 'Figure 3: ...', 'Table 2. ...').
applicability: The region is a caption line for a figure or a table (often starting with 'Figure' / 'Table' / 'Fig.' and a number).
It sits directly above or below the figure or table it labels.
instructions: Emit each caption as ONE block of block_type caption, carrying the caption text.
Attach the caption to the figure or table it describes via parent_block_id when that element is on the page; otherwise leave parent_block_id null.
Keep the caption separate from body prose and from the figure/table content itself; do NOT fold a caption into the paragraph before it.
A caption is not a heading and not a body paragraph.

provenance.reason: General-document adaptation (MPDocBench): figure/table captions are a distinct scored element (figure_caption / table_caption).
